task.title: Materialize the next available recurrence occurrence through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/957 to expose bounded atomic next-available materialization as a thin writable adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Validate recurrence ID, task ID, and page size before storage access.
Delegate ordering, cursor, replay, contention, and atomic task binding to the kernel.
Document and emit deterministic null/all-gap and success outcomes with stable diagnostics.

attempts.diagnostic: CLI integration tests failed because recurrence materialize-next was not recognized.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the issue contract before completing the production boundary.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented the command, validation, writable delegation, shared materialized JSON, task collision behavior, tests, and ADR-0081.
attempts.patch: Implemented the issue 957 contract in crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs with focused tests and synchronized architecture and behavior documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit found missing all-gap cursor documentation and incomplete validation-error documentation; commit 079b06d fixed both, both threads resolved, and rate-limited statuses were excluded until genuine exact-head review.
attempts.patch: Applied blocking findings where present, reran verification, required substantive review, and preserved zero unresolved review threads before merge.

outcome.summary: Issue 957 delivered the documented recurrence boundary with strict evidence, bounded authority, and verified merge provenance.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 958 exact head

lessons: All-gap cursor advancement is part of the public contract.
Adapters should preserve kernel-owned ordering and atomicity.
A rate-limited green status is not substantive review evidence.
